task: YCOR 可通行草地代理模型
scope: 方案比较：领域训练 LR-ASPP vs 未领域训练 B0 grass 代理；非安全可割评测

frozen.classification: argmax after bilinear logits interpolation; align_corners=False

timing_protocol.order: alternate model order for each repeat/image
timing_protocol.preprocess: decoded RGB PIL -> resize/normalize -> CPU tensor -> H2D; CUDA synchronize
timing_protocol.postprocess: logits bilinear to 384x512 -> argmax -> binary -> D2H numpy uint8; CUDA synchronize
timing_protocol.pipeline: wall time encompassing all three stages including transfers and synchronization
timing_protocol.excluded: disk I/O, image decoding (predecoded RGB input), load, download, visualization, save, metrics, HTTP
timing_protocol.limitations: laptop power/temperature not locked; both models resident; local machine only

boundary: 4-neighbour transitions, both sides, no frame perimeter; radius 2 Chebyshev at 512x384; exclude all boundary pixels within radius+1 of ignore in BOTH masks
